screen.title: Dhan jodo
screen.why: Bot aapke hi Dhan account me trade karta hai — paisa hamesha aapke broker ke paas rehta hai, hamare paas kabhi nahi.
screen.where_to_find: web.dhan.co → Profile → Client ID (upar likha hota hai). Token: Profile → 'Access DhanHQ APIs' → Generate.

screen.title: Bot kya karega
screen.decision: Ek baar padh lo: bot kya karega aur kya KABHI nahi karega.
screen.why: Confirm se pehle poori tasveer ek jagah — koi chhupi baat nahi.

will_do: 'BSE Ltd Momentum (test listing)' strategy ke signal par hi trade — aapko har trade khud nahi dabana.
Sirf BSE Ltd FUTURES, 2 lot (400 shares) — isse zyada kabhi nahi.
ABHI ASLI ORDER NAHI JAYEGA: bot sirf paper (practice) trade likhega, taaki aap dekh sako strategy kya karti hai. Asli paise ke liye alag se aapki haan aur hamara switch chahiye.
Rozana nuksaan ki limit Rs 63,105 aapke account me save hogi.
Dashboard par aapki position, Dhan par stop hai ya nahi, aur aaj ka P&L (Dhan ke bill se) dikhega.
will_never_do: Aapke Dhan se paisa nikalna ya transfer karna — hamare code me aisa koi rasta hi nahi hai.
Aapke chune 2 lot se zyada size — size sirf aap badal sakte ho.
Options ya cash me trade — woh band hain jab tak unka record saabit na ho.
Password, PIN, OTP ya Dhan token chat me maangna — AlgoMitra bhi kabhi nahi maangega.
Aapki haan ke bina shuru hona — aur STOP ke baad khud dobara chalu hona.
not_yet: Asli order bhejna (order lane band hai) — abhi sab paper.
Aapke account ke liye Dhan par apne aap stop-loss lagana — yeh hissa abhi bana nahi hai. Dashboard par 'broker par stop' ki line yahi sach dikhayegi.
Rozana nuksaan ki limit par bot ko apne aap band karna — limit save hoti hai, par abhi band karne wala hissa bana nahi hai.
